# DiceAlly 2.3.0

- Add an info button to switch between source abbreviations and full publication titles in the creator and compendium Source Books selectors.
- Include reviewed standard book titles and metadata from installed homebrew and prerelease files.
- Search by full title or abbreviation while retaining source IDs for selection. Expanding a title does not change the selected books.

Validation: 60 focused Angular tests passed across the shared source selector, title toggle, and both compendium views, including imported titles, unknown sources, full-title search, and unchanged checkbox selection.
